quarterly_data.signal: CEO Hock Tan on Broadcom's own AI adoption, in earnest for one year: 'We have engaged 15,000 of our 30,000 engineers in the company in looking at both in hardware and software.' He calls pure productivity ROI 'debatable' and says the clear return is quality and 'accelerated time to deployment or creation of leading-edge technology': if engineers 'have a bug and have to respin, that's six months and $30 million for leading-edge silicon', and OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini tools 'could help us eliminate the need for that respin'. He also cited cybersecurity scanning of Broadcom's infrastructure through Mythos.
quarterly_data.figure: 15,000 of our 30,000 engineers engaged; a leading-edge silicon respin costs six months and $30 million
